purpose: Exploratory single-session cross-subject feasibility check; not a confirmatory result
protocol: Within each dataset and selected session separately, leave one subject out; train on all other subjects; evaluate only the held-out subject

smoke.interpretation: Engineering-only; checks data, labels, model dimensions and one LOSO fold

single_session_loso.interpretation: Future exploratory full LOSO run; do not launch as part of the current code-and-smoke task

known_limitations: SEED and SEED-V have different label spaces and are analyzed separately; do not pool their scores.
The shared runner reports epoch-wise target evaluation and historical target-accuracy selection; resulting best-epoch scores are exploratory and optimistic.
One session cannot establish robustness across sessions. Repeat the frozen protocol on the remaining sessions before making cross-session claims.
Target-label-driven best-epoch selection is not a publication-grade model-selection protocol; use a source-only validation rule or a fixed final epoch for confirmatory evaluation.
